candidates.body: Ruby added a mascot clause to the closing routine: the bakery cannot be locked until the mascot is confirmed to be outside as well.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Creates a practical rule that can be tested or complicated once a mascot actually exists.

candidates.body: Tyson proposed installing a tiny bell to warn anyone who reaches for the bakery door without thinking.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Preserves a recurring gag or a possible future bakery fixture tied to the lockout.

candidates.body: Ruby said she would be deeply embarrassed if the eventual mascot proves better at closing the bakery than she and Tyson are.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Sets up an easy comic payoff if the mascot becomes unexpectedly competent.
